purpose: Reconciled identity, source assets, shipping components, prototype references and pending candidates. Design and UX principles apply to all states and devices regardless of artwork.

statuses.shipped: Active production component or deployed asset on main.
statuses.production-source: Source for built/deployed art or derivative.
statuses.prototype-with-shipped-source: Mixed directory; shipped source and unshipped interaction fixture require separation.
statuses.reference: Useful design illustration/research, not a shipped behavior contract.
statuses.historical: Retained old/alternative design; not current visual authority.
statuses.marketing-source: Campaign asset source, not production app controls.
statuses.proposed: Design handoff on an unmerged branch, requires review.
statuses.candidate: Reusable source that overlaps with shipped UI, no auto-merge.
statuses.invalid: Broken or placeholder source that must never be shipped.
